label: Agency grid
summary: Minimal editorial agency grid — oversized type, quiet labels, open space
spec:
LAYOUT: disciplined multi-column editorial grid with large open spans and generous negative space; hero headline spans most of the grid with supporting copy anchored in a narrow side column.
PALETTE: light neutral backgrounds, subtle tonal shifts, thin separators; one restrained accent used sparingly.
TYPE: oversized headlines with tight tracking and strong line breaks as the primary visual anchor; tiny uppercase utility labels and metadata; calm, sparse body copy.
SIGNATURE MOVES: service/capability rows as clean multi-column listings with tiny metadata; large architectural image blocks framed by whitespace, not chrome; understated CTAs with thin borders and small uppercase labels.
avoid: generic repeated card grids, heavy borders or shadows, accent overuse, filling every gap with content.

label: Editorial tech
summary: Magazine composition meets product-tech precision — asymmetric grid, mono labels
spec:
LAYOUT: asymmetrical editorial composition with strong column structure and deliberate negative space; cinematic media bands or inset image strips that cut across the grid; offset alignment instead of centered hero blocks.
PALETTE: restrained dark or controlled light neutrals with one active accent for states, numeric highlights, and focal separators.
TYPE: large expressive display headlines paired with quiet sans body and mono utility labels, counters, and metadata.
SIGNATURE MOVES: chapter markers, step lists, mono counters, thin divider rules and grid traces that make the page feel engineered; premium thin-framed panels rather than soft lifestyle surfaces.
avoid: centered generic SaaS heroes with interchangeable cards, sci-fi neon chrome, multi-color palettes, accent everywhere.

label: Framed grid
summary: Visible 1px frames and corner brackets on a strict parent grid — precise, technical
spec:
LAYOUT: strict parent grid (e.g. 12 columns) where every section snaps to the same columns and rows; each section is a framed box with a 1px border, consistent padding, and consistent gaps; sections use explicit grid spans, not ad-hoc widths.
PALETTE: neutral background (e.g. #f7f7f4), one border color at low contrast, one stronger line color for accents; very subtle diagonal line texture (≤0.05 opacity) as surface tension.
TYPE: clean sans with calm hierarchy; headings, controls, and media edges all aligned to the same grid rhythm.
SIGNATURE MOVES: L-shaped corner brackets (≈18px) repeated on all major frames; the visible frame IS the structure — no shadows.
avoid: floating cards, soft blobs, uneven margins, mixed border weights, heavy shadows, decorative texture.

label: Split technical
summary: Two-panel split screen — immersive media one side, specs and metadata the other
spec:
LAYOUT: strong two-panel split (≈50/50 on desktop, stacked on mobile) where each half has a distinct role — one immersive/visual, one informational with specs, metadata, or navigation; thin frame lines, inset rules, and tiny corner markers give each panel a technical shell.
PALETTE: restrained neutrals with one selective accent for active details and system cues, never a blanket wash.
TYPE: quiet editorial headlines with controlled tracking, supported by mono utility text for top rails, metadata strips, and spec labels.
SIGNATURE MOVES: one premium inset surface (bordered media frame or visualization window); compact two-column spec blocks with thin dividers; asymmetric density — one panel denser, one more spatial.
avoid: generic two-column marketing layouts, equally crowded panels, rounded playful UI, bright multi-color treatments.

label: Wireframe dark
summary: Monochrome technical diagram — outlined geometry, annotations, dark diagnostic frame
spec:
LAYOUT: wide, sparse composition on a near-black foundation; a large outlined/wireframe central object (SVG linework, no external libs) as the structural anchor, surrounded by open space with floating info labels connected by thin routed or dashed lines.
PALETTE: almost entirely monochrome — black, charcoal, zinc, white; emphasis from brightness and line weight, not color.
TYPE: compact technical type — small labels, utility copy, metric text, and only one or two larger heading moments.
SIGNATURE MOVES: exploded/layered outlined geometry suggesting readable components; edge-anchored diagnostic tags with tiny status dots; a low-contrast monochrome widget row (legend, allocation bars); faint halftone or technical pattern overlay.
avoid: filled glossy 3D renders, bright accent colors, dense dashboard cards competing with the diagram, label clutter.

label: Minimal beige
summary: Warm beige light mode — layered stone surfaces, quiet process grid, sparse accent
spec:
LAYOUT: centered master container or framed shell on layered beige/stone/cream surfaces; simple centered hero above a modular lower grid of evenly divided process blocks with consistent heights.
PALETTE: warm neutrals (beige, stone, parchment) with very low-contrast borders and subtle tonal separation; one sparse accent reserved for badges, active states, and primary actions.
TYPE: modern clean sans, modest weight contrast, quiet tracking, balanced spacing.
SIGNATURE MOVES: gentle radial wash behind the main UI instead of flat white; thin dividers over shadows; small dark inset cards used sparingly as contrast moments; tiny status dots and low-key progress indicators.
avoid: stark white SaaS with cold gray borders, ornate paper textures, heavy shadows, high-saturation accents, noisy over-filled modules.

label: Dark glass
summary: Premium dark workspace — frosted shells, floating cards, atmospheric depth
spec:
LAYOUT: centered max-width workspace shell on a near-black base — pill top nav, optional side shells, and a calm central stage; thin vertical boundary rails and tiny corner markers keep it architectural; a few floating glass cards around the center, generously spaced.
PALETTE: monochrome — white, zinc, smoke, charcoal; accent only for status dots and tiny indicators.
TYPE: compact operational headings with mono micro-labels, system IDs, and tiny metadata for technical credibility.
SIGNATURE MOVES: dark frosted glass shells (low-opacity dark fills, strong backdrop blur, crisp top-edge highlight, 1px gradient borders); soft atmospheric glow behind the interface; terminal-like I/O cards with clean inner rows.
avoid: bright translucent cards over colorful blobs, flat black boxes with no depth, center overcrowding, neon glows, glass as card-style-only.

label: Orange paper SaaS
summary: Warm paper tones with orange signal color — rounded, polished, product-led
spec:
LAYOUT: large rounded master container with subtle gradient-border treatment on a warm shell; pair a functional area (form, onboarding, content) with a polished product-visual panel of floating cards or soft white UI chips.
PALETTE: warm off-white, cream, parchment, pale stone surfaces — never stark white; orange as the disciplined signal color for CTAs, step markers, focus rings, and micro-badges.
TYPE: clean sans, light-to-regular body weight, restrained hierarchy — elegant and approachable.
SIGNATURE MOVES: paper-toned inputs with delicate borders and orange focus rings; rounded white/cream cards with soft orange-tinted shadows; orange primary button with quiet secondary actions.
avoid: cold blue-gray SaaS UI, flat white forms, saturating the page with orange, vintage paper distressing, noisy illustration.

label: Paper technical
summary: Warm paper interior framed by a dark outer shell — tactile but precise
spec:
LAYOUT: dark outer page field holding one large light rounded container with the whole experience inside; inner framing via inset border rectangles, small corner brackets, and quiet technical rules over paper-toned backgrounds.
PALETTE: warm off-white/parchment primary surfaces layered with slightly darker paper tones and soft borders; one restrained accent for active states, progress marks, and primary CTAs.
TYPE: clean sans for interface content with optional mono utility text for timestamps, captions, and metadata.
SIGNATURE MOVES: low-contrast diagonal texture on large paper regions; nested app panels (mockups, sidebars, transcript panes) with bright clean interiors and delicate border hierarchy; accent-driven live states (active bullets, highlighted words).
avoid: flat plain white layouts, vintage distressing, cold enterprise blue-gray, over-softened consumer roundness, accent overuse.

label: Industrial skeuo
summary: High-contrast molded dark shell — tactile depth, crisp light separation
spec:
LAYOUT: light outer page framing one dominant dark (black/charcoal) rounded master shell; inside, a disciplined grid of molded cards and instrument-like modules with fine guide lines and corner markers.
PALETTE: high contrast — near-white text on deep dark surfaces, muted gray support copy; one restrained signal accent for status lights, active markers, and progress slivers.
TYPE: clean sans with occasional mono labels; precise, not ornamental.
SIGNATURE MOVES: tactile depth via 1px gradient borders, top-edge highlights, dark-to-darker fills, and inset shadow stacks — clean and controlled, never glossy; touchable buttons with subtle bevel and measured hover brightness; selective skeuomorphic objects (windows, search plates, status widgets).
avoid: washed-out neumorphism, retro glossy leather/chrome gimmicks, flat monochrome with no depth, multiple accents, depth effects on everything.

label: Airbnb Travel Marketplace
summary: Photography-driven travel marketplace with Rausch coral accent, rounded UI, and dense typographic system.
spec:
LAYOUT: Max width 1760px; 6-col grid scaling down. Detail page 58% main / 36% sticky booking panel. Section padding 48-64px, mobile 24-32px. Radius: 4px chips, 8px buttons, 14px cards, 20px pills, 32px search, 50% circles.
PALETTE: Canvas #ffffff, Ink #222222. Rausch #ff385c primary CTA, #e00b41 pressed. Soft Cloud #f7f7f7, Hairline #dddddd borders, Ash #6a6a6a secondary.
TYPE: Airbnb Cereal VF only (fallback Circular); 500/600/700, no 400. Heading 28px/700, card title 21px/700, body 16px/500, badge 11px/600 uppercase.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Full-bleed 4:3/16:9 photography with 14-20px rounding; 3D category icons with typographic tabs; circular 50% icon buttons; sticky booking panel; Guest Favorite laurel-wreath rating.
avoid: multi-color palettes, flat illustration, sharp corners, serif/display fonts, cluttered grids, muted CTAs, unrounded photography.

label: Apple Precision Editorial
summary: Cinematic black/light chapters, thin chrome, SF Pro typography, single blue accent, pill CTAs.
spec:
LAYOUT: 8px grid; black #000000 hero chapters alternate pale #f5f5f7 fields; tight commerce grids; radius tiers 8-18px cards, 980px pill CTAs.
PALETTE: #000000, #f5f5f7, #1d1d1f text, #0071e3 action blue, #6e6e73 secondary, #d2d2d7 borders.
TYPE: SF Pro Display (hero, semibold, tight leading) + SF Pro Text (body/UI); 80px hero to 12px micro labels.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Thin chrome, imagery carries weight; pill/capsule CTAs; surface contrast over shadows; dual showcase/transaction modes.
avoid: Secondary accent palettes, decorative gradients/glows, loose tracking, single corner radius, thick borders, loud effects, splitting marketing vs commerce systems.

label: Bento
summary: Modular card grid with peach-and-cream palette, soft spacing, and scannable hierarchy.
spec:
LAYOUT: Compose a modular grid of card-like blocks with consistent internal padding; headline → support text → primary action per card; use whitespace before borders or shadows.
PALETTE: Peach primary #FAD4C0 for CTAs; cream surface #FFF5E6 for cards and backgrounds; text #111827; secondary #80A1C1; success #16A34A, warning #D97706, danger #DC2626.
TYPE: Inter for headings and body; JetBrains Mono for code; scale 12/14/16/20/24/32; weights 100–900; headings carry personality, body maximizes scanability.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Peach CTA buttons pop against cream cards; consistent radii and elevation across all blocks; strong focus-visible inputs with clear labels.
avoid: Off-palette colors when tokens exist; flat hierarchy via uniform type size/weight; decorative effects that hurt readability; mixing unrelated visual metaphors.

label: BMW — German Precision
summary: Dark cinematic hero photography + white content sections, ultra-light uppercase display type, sharp corners, BMW Blue accent only for interaction.
spec:
LAYOUT: Full-bleed dark hero photos alternating with white sections; 8px grid; sharp 0px radius; generous hero padding, compressed body spacing.
PALETTE: #fff surfaces; #262626 text; #757575 meta; #1c69d4 accent only; #0653b6 focus; #bbbbbb muted.
TYPE: BMWTypeNextLatin Light 300 uppercase 60px hero; 900 nav; 400 body 16px; line-heights 1.15–1.30.
SIGNATURE MOVES: 300-vs-900 weight contrast; single font family; blue only on interactive elements; showroom lighting rhythm.
avoid: Rounded corners; blue backgrounds; weights 500–600; decorative elements; loose line-heights; lightening dark heroes.

label: Brutalism
summary: Raw concrete anti-design: heavy type, hard edges, jarring layouts, functional minimalism.
spec:
LAYOUT: Stack bold, unadorned blocks edge-to-edge; hard 0px radii; asymmetric grids with visible misalignment; oversized headers crashing into content; no soft shadows or gradients.
PALETTE: Primary #DD614C for CTAs; Surface #FFFFFF for large blocks; Text #111827 for body; Secondary #DAA144, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626 only as tokens.
TYPE: Darker Grotesque for all headings, heavy weights 800-900, tight leading; JetBrains Mono for labels and meta; body at readable weight 400-500, high contrast.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Raw exposed structure—visible borders, stark dividers, brutalist typographic scale; functional elements look bolted-on, not polished; use mono for technical annotations.
avoid: Off-palette colors, rounded corners, soft shadows, gradients, decorative flourishes, flattened hierarchy, mixing unrelated metaphors, anything that softens the concrete edge.

label: Claymorphism
summary: Soft, puffy 3D clay-like shapes with playful rounded surfaces, high-contrast colors, and expressive typography.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding, obvious hierarchy (headline→support→action), whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #3B82F6, Surface #FFFFFF, Text #1C398E, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626.
TYPE: Montserrat (primary), Poppins (display), JetBrains Mono (mono); weights 100-900; expressive headings, scannable body.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Puffy rounded 3D clay shapes, soft inner/outer shadows, playful high-contrast color pops, bold CTA in Primary.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flat hierarchy (same size/weight), decorative effects hurting readability, mixed visual metaphors.

label: Coinbase
summary: Clean, trustworthy crypto platform: Coinbase Blue on white/near-black, ultra-tight display type, pill CTAs, alternating light/dark sections.
spec:
LAYOUT: 8px base spacing; alternating white (#ffffff) and near-black (#0a0b0d) sections; pill CTAs 56px radius; cards 12-16px radius.
PALETTE: Coinbase Blue #0052ff (functional only); hover #578bfa; cool gray surface #eef0f3; dark card #282b31; text #0a0b0d.
TYPE: CoinbaseDisplay hero (80px, weight 400, line-height 1.00); CoinbaseSans UI/buttons (16px, 600); CoinbaseText body (18px, 400, 1.56).
SIGNATURE MOVES: 56px pill buttons with blue hover; ultra-tight display headings; lowercase button labels; blue used only for function, never decoration.
avoid: decorative blue, sharp CTA corners, playful/rounded display fonts, multi-color accents, loose heading line-heights, skeuomorphic crypto imagery.

label: Cosmic
summary: Dark sci-fi with neon blue/violet accents, Audiowide display type, and playful-premium spatial energy.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding, obvious hierarchy: headline → support → primary action. Whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #3B82F6, Secondary #8B5CF6, Surface #FFFFFF, Text #111827. Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626.
TYPE: Audiowide for headings/display, JetBrains Mono for mono. Scale 12/14/16/20/24/32. Weight 400.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Neon blue CTA emphasis, dark-space contrast with white cards, futuristic Audiowide headlines, mono accents for data.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flat hierarchy (same size/weight), decorative effects hurting readability, mixed visual metaphors.

label: Discord Dark UI
summary: Dark-first chat surface with 3-step depth, Blurple accent, gg sans, rounded-square avatars, tight rows.
spec:
LAYOUT: Dark-first 3-step depth (#1e1f22 rail, #2b2d31 sidebar, #313338 chat). Rounded-square server avatars (16px) snap to circles on hover. Tight chat rows (4-8px), generous side-panel padding.
PALETTE: Blurple #5865f2 (only saturated accent), hover #4752c4. Text #dbdee1, muted #949ba4, link #00a8fc. Status: online #23a55a, idle #f0b232, dnd #f23f43. Dividers rgba(255,255,255,0.06).
TYPE: gg sans (fallback Helvetica/Arial). 16px body, 1.375 line-height. Weight contrast (400-800) over color. Mono: gg mono.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Blurple on dark neutrals only. 8px card radius, 4px inputs, full pills on badges. 1px subtle dividers. Hover overlays rgba(78,80,88,0.3).
avoid: Light backgrounds, saturated colors beyond blurple, balloon-soft radii, tiny fonts, high color contrast, decorative gradients.

label: Dithered Retro
summary: Modern minimal dot-pattern retro with high-contrast limited palette.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding. Hierarchy: headline → support → primary action. Whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #3B82F6, Secondary #8B5CF6, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626. Surface #FFFFFF, Text #111827.
TYPE: Open Sans body, Space Grotesk display, IBM Plex Mono. Scale 14/16/18/24/32/40.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Dot-pattern rendering for shades. Primary for CTA. High-contrast, limited palette.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flat hierarchy, decorative effects hurting readability, mixed metaphors.

label: Doodle
summary: Hand-drawn sketch style with Delius Swash Caps, imperfect lines, and playful doodle accents.
spec:
LAYOUT: Sketch-like composition with tilted cards, wobbly borders, and hand-drawn dividers. Keep blocks airy; let doodles fill negative space.
PALETTE: Primary #49B6E5 for CTAs and accents. Surface #FFFFFF for cards. Text #111827 for body. Secondary #263D5B for depth. Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626 only for status.
TYPE: Delius Swash Caps for all headings and display. JetBrains Mono for code or labels. Scale 14/16/18/24/32/40. Headings playful, body crisp and legible.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Hand-drawn underline strokes under headings. Slightly rotated doodle arrows or stars near key actions. Rough, uneven border radii on cards. Scribble-style focus rings on inputs.
avoid: Perfect straight lines, geometric precision, corporate flatness, off-palette colors, uniform type weights, decorative clutter that hurts readability.

label: Duolingo
summary: Gamified, friendly, tactile SaaS with owl-green primary, chunky 3D buttons, and big rounded type.
spec:
LAYOUT: White bg, 2-3px solid borders (#e5e5e5), 16-20px card radii, 12px buttons, 9999px chips. Mascot as character.
PALETTE: Owl Green #58cc02 (primary, 30%+ surface), #58a700 pressed, #89e219 hover, #dbf8c5 pale. Accents: #ff9600 streak, #ce82ff gems, #1cb0f6 hints, #ff4b4b wrong, #ffc800 badge. Text #3c3c3c, #777777 secondary.
TYPE: Feather Bold (display/headings/buttons, 800 weight, 56px display, 32px H1, 24px H2, 18px H3). Body: Mona Sans 15-17px. Caption 13px.
SIGNATURE MOVES: 4px bottom-shadow on every button (tactile press). Big confident type. Green underline-stroke or pill on headings. Color-coded skill icons.
avoid: Hairlines, sharp corners, thin fonts, muted palette, static logo-only mascot, subtle shadows, small type.

label: Editorial
summary: Magazine-inspired refined serif layout with structured grids and elegant reading experience.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding, obvious hierarchy (headline→support→action), whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #111111, Surface #FFFFFF, Text #111827, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626.
TYPE: Gelasio display+body, Ubuntu Mono mono; scale 14/16/18/24/32/40; headings carry personality, body optimizes scanability.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Near-black #111111 CTA emphasis on white cards; serif headlines with mono accents; generous whitespace separating content blocks.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flattened hierarchy (same size/weight), decorative effects hurting readability, mixed visual metaphors.

label: Fantasy
summary: Bold, premium game-inspired fantasy with rich token colors and New Rocker display type.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding, obvious hierarchy (headline → support → CTA), whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #0250CC, Secondary #FDC800, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626, Surface #FFFFFF, Text #111827.
TYPE: New Rocker for headings/display, IBM Plex Mono for mono; scale 12/14/16/20/24/32; body optimized for scanability.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Primary blue CTAs, white cards on large backgrounds, dark text for legibility, bold display headings.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flat hierarchy (same size/weight), decorative effects hurting readability, mixed visual metaphors.

label: Ferrari Editorial
summary: A chiaroscuro digital editorial: absolute black cinematic voids alternating with crisp white panels, Ferrari Red reserved as a surgical CTA accent, and FerrariSans typography with uppercase Body-Font labels for print-magazine hierarchy.
spec:
LAYOUT: Full-bleed black hero; alternating black/white sections as gallery rooms; 2-col editorial grids; 4-col footer; 2px border-radius; no box-shadows.
PALETTE: Absolute Black #000000; Pure White #FFFFFF; Ferrari Red #DA291C (CTA only); Dark Surface #303030; Near Black #181818; Dark Gray #666666; Border Gray #CCCCCC.
TYPE: FerrariSans (fallback Arial/Helvetica) for headings/UI at 500-700 weight; Body-Font uppercase with 1px letter-spacing for labels/captions; section titles 26px, nav 13px.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Red appears only on Subscribe CTA and key actions; uppercase wide-tracked labels; 2px radius buttons; depth via surface contrast, not shadows.
avoid: Scattering red as decoration; pill buttons or large radii; box-shadows; mixing fonts in one block; colorful backgrounds; uppercase FerrariSans headings; low-quality imagery; busy multi-focal layouts.

label: Figma
summary: A design-tool aesthetic: monochrome interface chrome (pure black/white) with vibrant multi-color gradient hero content, custom variable font with unusual weight stops, pill/circle button geometry, and dashed focus outlines.
spec:
LAYOUT: 8px base grid; max 1920px; gallery-like whitespace; pill (50px) & circle (50%) buttons; dashed 2px focus outlines.
PALETTE: Interface strictly #000000 + #ffffff; glass rgba(0,0,0,0.08) & rgba(255,255,255,0.16); vibrant hero gradient (green, yellow, purple, pink).
TYPE: figmaSans variable (weights 320/330/340/450/480/540/700); figmaMono uppercase labels; negative letter-spacing everywhere; kern on.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Monochrome chrome vs colorful product content; light-weight body (320-340); hero 86px tight -1.72px; dashed focus echoes editor handles.
avoid: No interface colors beyond black/white; no standard weights (400/500/600); no sharp corners; no solid focus outlines; no positive letter-spacing on body.

label: Flat
summary: Two-dimensional minimalist style with vibrant colors and no 3D effects.
spec:
LAYOUT: Flat planes only; stack clear content blocks with consistent padding. Hierarchy: headline → support text → primary action. Separate sections with whitespace, not shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #F2673C for CTAs. Surface #FFFFFF for backgrounds and cards. Text #111827 for body. Secondary #8B5CF6, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626. Never introduce off-palette colors.
TYPE: Inter for all text; JetBrains Mono for code. Scale 12/14/16/20/24/32. Weights 100–900. Headings carry personality; body optimizes scanability. Vary size/weight to keep hierarchy.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Vibrant orange CTA buttons on white cards. Flat, borderless sections with generous whitespace. Strong focus-visible states on inputs. Consistent radii and spacing across all components.
avoid: Gradients, shadows, 3D effects, decorative flourishes, off-palette colors, uniform type sizes, and mixed visual metaphors.

label: Framer Dark Void
summary: Cinematic pure-black canvas with compressed GT Walsheim headlines and electric Framer Blue accents — a nightclub for web designers where product screenshots are the hero art.
spec:
LAYOUT: Pure black void canvas; generous 80-120px section spacing; 40% text / 60% screenshot asymmetry; product UI as hero imagery; pill CTAs (100px radius), cards 10-15px.
PALETTE: #000000 bg; #ffffff text; #0099ff sole accent; #a6a6a6 secondary; rgba(255,255,255,0.1) frosted buttons; rgba(0,153,255,0.15) blue glow rings.
TYPE: GT Walsheim Medium 500 for display, extreme negative tracking (-5.5px at 110px); Inter for body with OpenType features; Mona Sans ultra-light (100) accents; no serifs.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Compressed spring-loaded headlines; frosted glass buttons; blue glow focus rings; flat black surfaces with subtle radial blue halos behind screenshots.
avoid: Warm darks (#1a1a1a); bold 700+ display; extra accent colors; heavy drop shadows; decorative illustrations; positive letter-spacing; light backgrounds; serif fonts.

label: GitHub
summary: Dense, engineered developer-tool UI on white or dark navy, hairline borders, system-ui + mono, Primer blue/green accents.
spec:
LAYOUT: Dense rectangular panes, hairline borders (#d0d7de), minimal whitespace, packed list rows, 16px octicons.
PALETTE: Canvas #ffffff / #0d1117, Primer blue #0969da, green #1a7f37, red #cf222e, muted text #656d76.
TYPE: system-ui stack, 14px body, 600 weight for headings, mono (SFMono/Menlo/Consolas) for code.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Pill badges with semantic colors, subtle blue/green/red surfaces (#ddf4ff, #dafbe1, #ffebe9), hairline dividers.
avoid: Decorative fonts, large whitespace, rounded cards, gradients, shadows, warm tints, oversized text.

label: Glassmorphism
summary: Frosted glass with translucent layers, subtle blur, and luminous borders for modern depth.
spec:
LAYOUT: Stack frosted panels with generous internal padding; lead with headline, support text, primary action. Use whitespace before borders or shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #1856FF for CTAs; Surface #FFFFFF for large backgrounds and cards; Text #141414 for body. Success #07CA6B, Warning #E89558, Danger #EA2143, Secondary #3A344E. Stay on-token.
TYPE: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and body; JetBrains Mono for code. Mobile-first compact scale; headings carry personality, body maximizes scanability. Weights 100–900.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Frosted glass cards with backdrop blur and translucent fills; luminous 1px borders catching light; layered depth via overlapping translucent surfaces; high-contrast bold accents on glass.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flat single-layer surfaces, decorative effects that hurt readability, mixing unrelated visual metaphors.

label: Gradient
summary: Modern, playful interfaces with smooth color transitions and gradient-rich surfaces for visual depth.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding; hierarchy headline → support text → primary action; whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Primary #990FFA, Secondary #E60076, Success #16A34A, Warning #D97706, Danger #DC2626, Surface #FFFFFF, Text #111827; favor Primary for CTAs, Surface for cards.
TYPE: Montserrat (primary), Space Grotesk (display), JetBrains Mono (mono); scale 12/14/16/18/24/30/36; headings carry personality, body optimizes scanability.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Gradient-rich surfaces (Primary→Secondary blends) for depth; bold display headings in Space Grotesk; high-contrast CTA in #990FFA on white.
avoid: Off-palette colors; flat hierarchy (same size/weight everywhere); decorative effects hurting readability; mixing unrelated visual metaphors.

label: Linear — Dark Precision SaaS
summary: Near-black canvas with luminous text hierarchy, Inter Variable at signature weight 510, and a single indigo-violet accent for CTAs. Ultra-thin translucent borders, compressed display headlines, and darkness-as-whitespace define this engineered, precise aesthetic.
spec:
LAYOUT: 8px grid; max-width 1200px; hero centered single-column; 2-3 col feature grids; 80px+ section padding; radius 4-12px; darkness as whitespace.
PALETTE: bg #08090a; panel #0f1011; surface #191a1b; text #f7f8f8; body #d0d6e0; muted #8a8f98; accent #5e6ad2/#7170ff; borders rgba(255,255,255,0.05-0.08).
TYPE: Inter Variable with "cv01","ss03"; display 72px/510/-1.584px; body 16px/400; mono Berkeley Mono; max weight 590.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Luminance-stepped surfaces instead of shadows; indigo only on CTAs/active; compressed headlines in vast dark space; translucent borders.
avoid: Pure #ffffff text; bold 700; positive letter-spacing on display; opaque borders; decorative indigo; warm colors; drop shadows for elevation.

label: Luxury Dark
summary: High-end dark aesthetic with bold Oswald headings, monochromatic black/white palette, and premium minimalism.
spec:
LAYOUT: Clear content blocks, consistent padding, obvious hierarchy (headline → support → action), whitespace before borders/shadows.
PALETTE: Surface #000000, Text #FFFFFF, Primary #FAFAFA for CTA emphasis; no off-palette colors.
TYPE: Oswald for headings/display, JetBrains Mono for mono; desktop-first expressive scale, bold weights; body text high contrast.
SIGNATURE MOVES: Black backgrounds with white text, oversized Oswald headlines, monochrome minimalism, CTA in #FAFAFA.
avoid: Off-palette colors, flat hierarchy (same size/weight), decorative effects hurting readability, mixed visual metaphors.

label: Mono Matrix
summary: Monospace-driven hacker-chic design with neon green accents and compact density.
spec:
LAYOUT: Compact, dense blocks with tight internal padding; hierarchy via size/weight contrast, not whitespace alone.
